### Marcus Aurelius on death

Marcus Aurelius (121–180) approaches death within Stoicism. Only judgment, impulse, and assent lie within our control; externals are indifferent materials for virtue. Cosmic nature is rational and providential; aligning with it is freedom. On this page, the archive isolates English passages where that project meets death most directly—useful for searches such as “marcus aurelius quotes on death.”
